notes.title: Demo v1.6.1 Update (Hotfix)
notes.notes:
Voice / Log
Fixed an issue where clicking Backlog / Play button / Options / Volume slider could also advance text.

Stabilized the play button (no more triggers from blank areas; improved hitbox and input handling).
UI
Fixed speaker name overlay when opening Options during story (layer order adjusted).

Fixed parameter icon offset on hover over training buttons.

Eased chapter goal text tightness (tracking / separators tuned).
Other
Fixed minor text/line-break glitches and typos.

Fixed an issue where animations could stop on Save/Load.

Please keep the feedback coming via reviews or the forums—it helps a lot. Thank you!

notes.title: Demo v1.6 Update Notice
notes.notes:
■ Highlights
・Line adjustments
・Reviewed the morning/night one-liners to match “her state of the day,” cleaned up contradictory phrasing, and improved readability.
・Minor tweaks to key chapter lines (softened stiff wording and chose vocabulary that conveys feelings).


■ UI Updates
・Refreshed the status display from numeric gauges to icons + tier labels.
・Unified chapter goals and weekly mini-goals into single-line display for better readability.
・Changed action preview chips from numbers to “verbs + arrows (— / ↑ / ↑↑ / ↑↑↑)”.

Unification and polish of terminology across languages (EN/ZH-CN/KO), adjusting inconsistent terms and stiff translations.


■ Bug Fixes
・Fixed some tooltip/chip display glitches (missing symbols/brackets).
・Corrected minor layout/line-break issues and typos.



Your feedback powers the next update.
Please keep playing and sharing your thoughts.
Warm reviews are a great encouragement!

notes.title: Demo Update Notice (ver1.5 — UI Improvements / Backlog & Auto-Advance)
notes.notes:
What’s in this update
・Reworked UI layout and font sizes in the raising part to improve readability.
・Added a Backlog feature (voice playback from the log supported).
・Implemented Auto-Advance (auto-stops at important scenes).
・Surfaced on-screen buttons: \[Options] \[Fast Skip] \[Auto].
・Added Save/Load to \[Options], so you can use them anytime in-game.
・You can now open Auto / Skip / Backlog / Options even during ADV scenes.

What’s next
・Bug fixes
・Further UI tuning (text size / readability)
・Fine-tuning of lines and direction


Your feedback directly helps us make a better game.
Please keep playing and let us know what you think.
Warm impressions and reviews are also very welcome!

notes.title: DEMO Version 1.4 Update
notes.notes:
Main Changes
Text Speed Settings: Added Fast Mode and Auto-Read options.

Protection Mode: Important story events will no longer be skipped.

UI Improvements: Fixed blurry text and improved resolution. More font visibility updates are planned.

Removed Unnecessary Options: Simplified confusing items such as “Dash.”

Faster Daily Cycle: With Fast Mode and Skip (read text), replays are smoother.

Dialogue Adjustments: Some lines were revised to better match the characters’ feelings.

BGM Adjustments: Unified music atmosphere in certain scenes.

Multilingual Fonts: Each language now loads its own font for better readability.


Coming Soon
Further improvements to font size and UI visibility

A new tutorial event at the beginning of the story

Additional tweaks to make gameplay more comfortable

Your feedback is invaluable in shaping this game.
We’d love to hear your thoughts and impressions—thank you for your support!
